(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

No. 1893/6 – MONDAY, DECEMBER 15, 2014
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: KDS/PDB/4/3/2/5 Land and Land Development Ministry Reference No.:
I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose:

Description of the land to be acquired: The allotment of land called “Viharawatta” in total extent of about 0.1125 Hectare, depicted as Lot No. 1 in the Preliminary Plan No. Maha 6386 dated 29.10.2014, surveyed and prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village of Doragamuwa in Pallegampaha Korale Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Pathadumbara in Kandy District, Central Province and bounded as follows:
Lot No. 1— Name of Land: Viharawatta; Extent: 0.1125 Hectare
Boundaries:
North: Viharawatta claimed by Sri Shailapabbatharama Viharaya, Doragamuwa and Road; East: Road and Viharawatta claimed by Sri Shailapabbatharama Viharaya, Doragamuwa; South: Viharawatta claimed by
Sri Shailapabbatharama Viharaya, Doragamuwa; West: Viharawatta claimed by Sri Shailapabbatharama Viharaya, doragamuwa;
Names and Address of the Claimants: 1. The Chief Incumbent” Sri Shailapabbatharama Viharaya, Daragamuwa.
2. Public Trustee, Department of Public Trustee, Colombo 07.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretary’s, office at Pathadumbara on the 28th day of January 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 21st day of January 2015, the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
L. A. SUJATHA WIJESINGHE, Divisional Secretary, Pathadumbara. Divisional Secretary’s Office, Pathadumbara, Wattegama. 12th December, 2014.
